proposedStacking: Use the stronger existing discount rather than adding discounts; an existing half-cost action stays half-cost.
structuralNotes: Do not discount generic settlement recursively. Explicitly distinguish actual action charges from pending half_action normalization.
Do not infer eligibility from stale target_skill or interaction_type alone.
Any fractional savings must be accumulated per character and persist through save, role swaps, grade changes and days; initialize only for a newly created character.
Free and cheat-suppressed actions must not generate savings.
AP discount must not refill saved AP or alter the base stamina/AP curve.

balance.limits: Long-run comparison of equal nominal 1AP costs and base XP. Existing XP modifiers, restrictions, exertion, money, rounding and actor roles change actual outcomes.
